INC report (session inc-4917-sre-alice)
========================================
Root cause: DB pool exhaustion caused by release rel‑2031, which lowered `maximumPoolSize` from 50 to 10 and upgraded the ORM.

Verification: p95 latency fell below the 400 ms SLO within 6 minutes after rollback.
